---
id: panther-chameleon
title: Panther chameleon
---
The panther chameleon (*Furcifer pardalis*) of Madagascar and nearby
islands changes colour for mood, temperature, and display more than for
simple camouflage. Eyes move independently. A ballistic tongue hits
insects at a distance greater than the body length. Males are vividly
patterned; females are often duller. Captive breeding supplies the pet
trade.
